# How much will childcare really cost me after the free hours and the 20% top-up?

> Free UK Tax-Free Childcare and 30 hours calculator for England: do you qualify, the value of free hours, the 20% top-up, what you pay a month and the Universal Credit alternative. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
